title: Field jacket on the alpine ridge

tokens.v: Catch him mid-stride cresting the ridge, small in the lower-left third, cloud sea taking the rest — jacket worn open, both front panels and the hem snapping downwind, grass laid flat in a travelling wave, hair pushed off his forehead. 35mm at f/8 from thirty metres out, below the trail line so he breaks the skyline. A lichen-crusted boulder blurs the near-right foreground, cut by the right and bottom edges. Dress him fully: charcoal ribbed merino crew, olive canvas trousers cuffed over brown lace-up leather hiking boots. Let the garment read unmarked.
